title: Serendipity
description: a shader aiming for a semi-realistic look
body:
this shader is an edit of "[The-Next-Shader](https://modrinth.com/shader/the-next-shader)" made by Coldnight and under Apache license. it aims to semi-realistic style, and high performance, with some basic stuff that the original work doesn't have.

## **features**
 * GTAO (ground truth ambient occlusion)
 * RSM (reflective shadow map)
 * SSPT (screen space path tracing)
 * atmospheric scattering
 * volumetric clouds
 * plane clouds
 * bloom
 * agx tonemap
 * water waves
 * rain puddles (from [Complementary](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined) with permission :D)
 * wet surface
 * basic POM (parallax occlusion mapping)
 * taa (temporal anti-aliasing)
 * specular reflection
 * motion blur
 * depth of field
 * volumetric fog
 * volumetric light
 * lens flare
 * screen space reflection
 * rain ripple
 * PCSS soft shadow

 idk what more, you can try it and find out

## **supported mods**
 * basic supported [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy)

 if you caught any issues (like game rendering, artifacts, or anything else), you can report them to me so i can fix them.. create issues [here⁠](https://github.com/lothanhchiton/serendipity/issues)
 
 this shader has been tested on Intel. it  should theoretically work on AMD and Nvidia, but I am not entirely sure.
 and can also load on mobile device using [MobileGlues](https://github.com/MobileGL-Dev/MobileGlues-release) and can also load with iphone using [Hynis](https://github.com/congcq/Hynis) launcher by [congcq](https://github.com/congcq) and some other renderer.
